content: The rollout removed the explicit `WEB_CONCURRENCY` setting. With that variable unset, gunicorn fell back to its default behavior – spawning one worker per visible CPU core (16 workers on the 16‑core nodes). The higher worker count exhausted the pod’s CPU quota, causing the CPU usage spike and the throttling that rose above ≈ 25 % of periods, even though the “configured” worker count in the deployment manifest had not changed. In short, the rollout unintentionally **unset `WEB_CONCURRENCY`**, causing gunicorn to auto‑scale its workers to the node’s core count and trigger the throttling.
name: gather
